clause: Autoflow placement modes + smart text reflow + overset detection [STU-LAY-020]

scope.summary: Implement autoflow placement modes when placing a loaded text cursor, enumerable: Manual (places one frame, cursor reloads with remainder), Semi-autoflow (places a frame, reloads cursor, no page add), Autoflow (adds frames and pages until story ends), Fixed-page autoflow (flows into existing pages only, no page add). Implement smart text reflow: automatically add or remove pages as a threaded story (scoped to primary text frames or to all frames) grows or shrinks. Overset-text condition MUST be detectable and is a preflight rule (MT-183). Anchored on primary text frame (MT-145).
acceptance_criteria: all four autoflow modes; smart text reflow adds/removes pages per scope; overset detectable
proof_targets: four-mode placement runtime; smart-reflow add/remove-pages + overset test
expected_tests: live: each of the four flow modes places/reloads/adds as specified
test: smart text reflow adds/removes pages as story grows/shrinks (primary-frame vs all-frame scope); overset detectable

target_entries: Studio / Page Layout / Autoflow & smart text reflow

risk_if_missed: Placing long text is fully manual; pages not auto-managed; overset undetected.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
